unit.why: Numbered section (צב) in an ongoing account of the master's last winter before his death. It continues the preceding sections and leads into the next one (צג), though it holds a small anecdote of its own.
unit.boundary_note: part of a multi-division death-of-the-tsaddik sequence spanning previous and next divisions

stories.start_quote: והנה מאז כל החורף לא היה
stories.end_quote: את בני אדם, כי כן דרך הצדיקים
stories.summary_en: During his last winter the master could not bear anyone and grew angry at everyone, and the tsaddik of Shedlovitz, who was with him then, later said he understood from this that the master's death was near, as is the way of tsaddikim.

tags.why: the master's anger at everyone is the central depicted trait
the episode belongs to the narrative of the master's approaching death
the imminent death of the tsaddik frames the anecdote

quotes: אז הבין שהוא סמוך להסתלקותו, מזה שלא היה יכול
tags.why: the Shedlovitz tsaddik grasped the hidden meaning of the master's irritability

quotes: ההק' משדלאווצי זצ״ל שאמר כי כאשר היה
tags.why: another tsaddik's stay with the master and his testimony about him

quotes: כאשר היה בחורף ההוא אצל מרן ז״ל
tags.why: the Shedlovitz tsaddik stayed with the master that winter

missing_concepts: signs of a tsaddik's approaching death (intolerance of people as a premonitory sign)
